gaps: G1: decidedBy cannot become a closed union — the human path stores an arbitrary approverRef string (interaction-resolution-response.ts:89); a typed field must be ADDED, not narrowed.
G2: the new source field must join PERMISSION_RESPONSE_FIELDS_AFTER_APPROVED (shared/ipc-signing.ts:11-18) or human-path provenance travels unsigned.
G3: no GANTRY_RUN_ID env exists — runId reaches the runner only in spawn input; the audit stamp needs it added at agent-spawn-helpers.ts:156.
G4: the permissionRunRestriction map is process-local and torn down at spawn exit — a late-arriving task finds no entry; missing entry must read as untrusted (deny mutations), never as interactive.
G5: deploy transition — permission_allowed payloads recorded before the change lack source; the pause predicate needs a legacy fallback so in-flight runs keep today's semantics.
contradictions: C1: assessment framed the host as unable to distinguish scheduled callers — the host ALREADY holds an unforgeable per-run binding (permissionRunRestriction keyed sourceAgentFolder+host-minted responseKeyId, registered where isScheduledJob is in scope); host state, not runner claims, is the trust root and the runner stamp is belt-and-braces.

C2: assessment implied new identity plumbing for the scheduled lane — permissionLane 'autonomous' already flows end to end (isScheduledJob → agent-spawn.ts:565 → GANTRY_PERMISSION_LANE → runner context); the surface filter reuses TOOLS-1's final-projection seam.
resolutions: G1: separate typed source + repeatableForFutureRuns derived in decisionForMode (the single choke point) from decidedBy via one map; unknown/free-form values map conservatively to human_once.
G2: source and repeatableForFutureRuns added to the signed field list with a tamper test.
G3: GANTRY_RUN_ID added beside GANTRY_JOB_ID; stamp lives in writeIpcFile's shared requestContext under the existing HMAC.
G4: mutate handlers deny on scheduled OR missing entries; documented as the safe default for the single-runtime deployment.
G5: predicate falls back to the old reviewed_rule string sniff when source is absent.
C1: B4 specifies host-side lookup by (sourceAgentFolder, responseKeyId) as the enforcement; the signed runner stamp is audit provenance only.
C2: B2 adds permissionLane to the selection options and drops the six mutation names in the applyProviderAffinity-style final pass, in both selection paths.
